Full suite green: 517/517. Two commits broke it, and I fixed the source in each.

- **`958d3ae` (thousands separators):** `formatMoney` used `padEnd` on the cents, so 1 cent printed as `$0.10`. I changed it to `padStart` in `src/money.js`. This also fixed the PIN-03 render row.
- **`4188e9a` (per-line discount groundwork):** `buildInvoice` set `taxable = subtotal`, so order-level codes like SPRING10 no longer reduced the taxed amount. I changed it to `subtotal - discount` in `src/invoice.js`. The line-discount support the commit added is untouched, since the subtotal is already net of line discounts.

The changes are uncommitted in the working tree.
